name: Spirit Chain
body:
Prerequisite(s): Nganga level 7th, Wisdom 15.

Benefit: Once per day, when you use your Ancestral Guidance ability, you can immediately follow it with your Healing Ritual as a swift action.

The Healing Ritual in this case only takes 1 round to perform instead of 10 minutes. Additionally, the spell-like ability granted by your Ancestral Guidance gains a +2 bonus to its saving throw DC when used in this way.

Special: You can use this ability an additional time per day at 14th level.
